title: Basis on Which a Trip Earning Reaches a Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
A trip's earning is the guest's trip price less the marketplace's share, worked out on the host protection plan in force on the day the trip started, and it becomes payable the schedule's delay period in whole calendar days counted from the day the trip started, the day of the start itself not counted.

## Entries and their bases

| Money in question | How it reaches the Keyturn Host Payout Account |
|---|---|
| The trip price | As the trip earning, being the price less the marketplace's share |
| Mileage, fuel, late return and cleaning overage the guest pays | Each as its own entry on its own basis, following the same share as the trip price, never folded into the trip earning |
| A cancellation fee the guest bore on a trip cancelled before it started | As its own entry on the cancellation basis, being the host's share of that fee |
| A trip fee offset carried by the host protection plan | As its own entry, rather than lifting the trip earning |

Money is never posted for a trip that was cancelled before it started, except where the guest bore a cancellation fee. The trip fee offset posts separately so that the statement shows what the marketplace kept and what it gave back.

## One entry to a trip on a basis

An earning is posted once for one trip on one basis, so two entries on the same account, the same day and the same basis must belong to different trips; the trip reference is what keeps them apart.

## The state the account must stand in

An earning is posted only while the account is in the active, on hold or suspended state, because an account that has closed has nothing further to settle. The position is taken from the account's own record of the state it stands in, read against the account's own reference number before the entry is posted, and not from what the host reports.

**Condition.** The account stands active, on hold or suspended. **Judgement.** The earning may be posted. **Result.** The entry is booked on its own basis for its own trip.

**Condition.** The account stands closed. **Judgement.** The earning is not posted. **Result.** Nothing further settles on that account.
